extracted_facts.statement: Sponsored Display has been officially renamed to Display Ads as part of Amazon's unified advertising platform strategy
extracted_facts.source_excerpt: 展示型推广现被称为展示广告。亚马逊正式推出统一的广告平台

extracted_facts.statement: Display Ads have been integrated into a unified display advertising system that combines functionality previously managed separately by Amazon DSP and the advertising platform
extracted_facts.source_excerpt: 展示型推广现已纳入亚马逊更广泛的展示广告体系，此体系融合了此前分别由亚马逊 DSP 和广告平台管理的功能

extracted_facts.statement: A new centralized management center integrates all Amazon advertising products, combining search advertising with Amazon DSP workflows on a single platform
extracted_facts.source_excerpt: 该中心统一接入所有亚马逊广告产品，将搜索广告与亚马逊 DSP 工作流汇聚于同一工作平台

extracted_facts.statement: Existing Sponsored Display campaigns continue uninterrupted and can be accessed through Campaign Manager in the advertising platform
extracted_facts.source_excerpt: 现有的展示型推广广告活动将继续不间断投放。您可以通过广告平台中的
访问现有的展示型推广广告活动

extracted_facts.statement: Display Ads can reach audiences across Amazon properties including Twitch, Fire TV, and Echo Show, as well as premium placements on the open internet
extracted_facts.source_excerpt: 可将您的展示广告活动投放到亚马逊全域资源（包括 Twitch、Fire TV 和 Echo Show）以及开放互联网上的优质版位

extracted_facts.statement: Display Ads support both Amazon-generated creative assets and custom creative assets for advertisers
extracted_facts.source_excerpt: 展示广告是一种灵活的广告格式，可以使用亚马逊生成的创意素材或您自己的创意素材

extracted_facts.statement: The unified platform maintains all powerful advertising functionality while providing simplified operations
extracted_facts.source_excerpt: 这一全新方向实现了您期待的简易操作，同时保留了您依赖的所有强大广告功能
